subject: problem with axis labels and facet_wrap

messages.author: 79cbcdf70bb4b9c6
messages.subject: problem with axis labels and facet_wrap
parts:
Hi all,

I've been trying to switch to ggplot for the figures in a paper I'm
writing. I'd like to thank Hadley Wickham for the amazing work he did
with this package, it's far superior to lattice in my opinion
(although it does take some getting used to).
I have one figure which is proving troublesome. It has 6 sub-plots,
obtained via faceting, each showing a 2D function as a heat map.
Because they are heat maps, I need the axes to be tight around the
data, otherwise there is some ugly white space around the heat maps.
So I set expand=c(0,0).
Here's the issue: the different heat maps have different (x,y) limits;
so I also need to set scale="free". Unfortunately the axis labels that
appear on the edge of each sub-plots are cut off and I can't seem to
find a way to set different labels in each sub-plot.
Here's a quick illustration of the problem:

dat <- data.frame(x=rep(1:10,2),y=rep(1:10,2),fac=gl(4,5))
qplot(x,y,data=dat) + facet_wrap(~ fac,scales="free") +
scale_x_continuous(breaks=at,expand=c(0,0))

I can always edit the plots later, but it'd be nice to have a work-
around. Thanks for your help!

Simon Barthelmé
